## Summary

Describe the change and why it is needed.

## Validation

- [ ] `npm ci --ignore-scripts` works in a clean checkout.
- [ ] `npm run check` passes.
- [ ] Relevant mock regression tests were added or updated.
- [ ] No credentials, raw authenticated requests, or private project data are included.
- [ ] README / changelog updated if behavior or compatibility changes.
- [ ] Upstream attribution and license preserved.

Live Devin validation (optional; never post tokens):

- [ ] Not performed.
- [ ] Performed; describe only the tested behavior and sanitized outcome.
